Summary

Structure in this individual's assembly, read from the sections below; not inheritance and not origin. See docs/guide, Chapter 6.

Ploidy

4 haplotype copies of each of 14 chromosome numbers (HAP2B, HAP2C split out of one haplotype file holding two chromosome sets); no older duplicated sets detected.

Confidence: high. Evidence: copies from the assembly (4 per number); extra set(s) matched one-to-one to the shared numbers

Auto-like or allo-like?

Auto-like (tetrasomic-like): on most chromosomes all copies are about equally close.

Confidence: high. Evidence: 14 chromosome numbers assessed: 0 split into lineages, 14 tetrasomic-like, 0 one divergent copy, 0 candidate

TE markers

Repeat history does not track the copies' lineages (no within-genome TE contrast).

Confidence: medium. Evidence: TE split >= 2 on 0/14 chromosomes (median 1.00); absolute te_marker_fraction 0.2673 (reference only)

Rediploidization

No sign yet: copies interchangeable throughout.

Confidence: medium. Evidence: 0 split / 14 tetrasomic-like chromosomes; 0 regional split(s); homeology map: 0% of the genome in 0 homeolog blocks, 0 chromosome pairs

Copy number and copy divergence (whole-chromosome matrix)

Hierarchically reordered, chromosome-number resolution

Same distance data as the heatmaps above, but collapsed to one value per chromosome NUMBER (haplotype copies aggregated away) and reordered by average-linkage clustering -- shows cross-chromosome (subgenome/ancestral-pair) structure cleanly, including diffuse structure with no individually FDR-significant pair.
